QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cassandra about her urgent request.
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra claims the #b#e#o9303026##k#n stole her shoes! She wants you to hunt them down when they show up on New Years at dawn to get her #r#e#t3994722##n#k back.
